g.text: • First, our project has many features, functions, tools, options and pages.
• Next, we have a long explanation of the process and every tiny detail.
• There are more words here than anyone can read during the presentation.
• And another point, with another explanation, and another explanation.
• We still have not shown the main problem or the useful result.
• Please read all of this while also listening to the presenter.
• One more thing! And one more thing! And one more thing!
